backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, authorization checks, ranking sorting, and profile save/query logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping logout‑related feature IDs to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summarized descriptions for various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base configuration defining light/dark theme variables and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document mounting the React app and loading the main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app managing routing, login gating, theme init, and backend profile sync.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup import/export utilities for serializing AppState with validation and migration handling.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup schema with versioning, validation, and migration logic for AppState.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated SVG circular progress component showing percentage with color-coded thresholds.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Displays a subject’s attendance stats with percentage, streak, trend, and optional premium insights.
Provides the main layout wrapper with header, footer, and responsive spacing to avoid nav overlap.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Bottom sheet for marking today’s classes, auto-loading scheduled subjects and saving attendance events.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a 5‑tab bottom navigation bar with active tab highlighting and icons.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Shows app branding, version, description, and founder info with theme‑aware logo.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Allows exporting and importing backups with confirmation before restoring data.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Provides a logout button with confirmation and loading state handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permissions, and sending test notifications.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: UI component for editing and validating a user's display name with edit/save/cancel states.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Allows users to set attendance target with slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Lets users choose light/dark/system theme and select a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for delete or other destructive actions.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing a subject with validation for duplicate names.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that displays a fallback screen and allows reloading the app.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo with theme-aware icon handling.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Displays non-blocking toast notifications when an error occurs.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure functions computing attendance stats, safe bunks, required classes, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer handling subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, user profile, points, and milestone awards.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Defines core domain types and default app state for subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, user profiles, and streak milestones.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Provides prediction, trend analysis, and motivational messaging utilities for premium insights.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Computes streak lengths and determines milestone eligibility with helper utilities.
Validates display names with trimming, length checks, and character rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, with query invalidation on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and provider managing Internet Identity login, storage, and state.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining themes, color tokens, animations, and motion settings.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: App branding constants and functions returning theme-aware logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility helpers for class merging, ID generation, date formatting, and color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Provides helper functions to build notification messages for class status updates and combined attendance markings.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Implements a wrapper for the browser Notifications API with permission checks, support detection, and error-handled notification sending.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing overall and per-subject stats, streak milestone checks, and controls for adding subjects and marking attendance.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple login page that validates a name, creates a user profile, and triggers login after a short async delay.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page enabling profile editing, theme and target adjustments, notification settings, backups, and full logout with data clearing.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Displays overall attendance statistics with a progress circle and breakdown of attended, missed, and cancelled classes.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Subject details view showing per-subject stats, safe bunk and target calculations, recent activity, and edit/reset/delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Renders a weekly timetable grid with edit mode for assigning subjects to day/period slots and syncing changes to app state.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Generates a lightweight animated confetti overlay using randomly positioned particles.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Legacy wrapper exposing ranking fetch and submit functions by delegating to RankingService.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Displays a stylized badge for a user’s rank, with special designs for ranks 1–3 and a generic gradient badge for others.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: Manages localStorage caching of ranking data with validation and safe read/write operations.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines UI ranking data types and helpers for mapping backend entries and validating ranking items.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Fetches ranking data from the backend with pagination and handles point submission for the current user.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Main leaderboard UI with polling, auto-scroll to user, Top-3 display, confetti, and error/loading handling.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Coordinates ranking data fetches, caching fallback, pagination, and points submission through the repository.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads actor and user context, then renders RankingScreen with current user info.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Provides a React Context store with reducer-based state, loading initial data from IndexedDB and debounced persistence back to storage.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Loads and saves AppState via IndexedDB, validating structure and merging defaults for missing settings or new fields.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Implements low-level IndexedDB operations for saving, loading, and clearing the serialized AppState.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies and initializes theme settings, toggling dark mode and theme variants with optional system‑theme listeners.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and manipulating hash‑based query params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, and layout settings with typography, container, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project scope, architecture, known issues, and high‑level requirements for BunkPro’s ranking and feature roadmap.
